name: Ninh Binh to Dong Hoi
summary: Take an SE train. The five southbound trains take 7 hours 21 minutes to 8 hours 40 minutes. The stations are 407 km apart on the rail posts. A road time is Check on arrival.

modes.note: Southbound, SE3 is the short end and SE9 is the long end. Ninh Bình is km 115 and Đồng Hới is km 522. Book a berth. Fares are Check on arrival.
No door-to-door minute is published. The 407 km figure is the rail post, not the highway. Fares are Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is Dong Hoi back to Ninh Binh the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. This page covers both directions. Northbound, the trains that stop take 7 hours 56 minutes to 8 hours 30 minutes. One northbound train does not show a Ninh Bình time. Fares are Check on arrival.
